copy.tagline: 快速集成 Redis 限流 SDK 到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 TypeScript 项目中使用 Redis 实现速率限制
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Redis rate limiting SDK into your app quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to implement rate limiting with Redis in a TypeScript project

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你生成使用 Upstash Redis 速率限制 TypeScript SDK 的代码，包括安装、创建限流器、检查请求是否被限流等。
howto.when: 当你询问如何用 TypeScript 实现 Redis 速率限制，或要求生成相关代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个基于滑动窗口的速率限制器，每秒最多5次请求。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的 TypeScript 代码。

say.text: 如何检查用户是否被限流？
say.note: Claude 会解释 limit 方法的返回值。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you generate code for using the Upstash Redis Rate Limit TypeScript SDK, including setup, creating a rate limiter, and checking if a request is throttled.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about implementing Redis rate limiting in TypeScript or request related code generation.

say_en.text: Write a sliding window rate limiter with max 5 requests per second.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the corresponding TypeScript code.

say_en.text: How do I check if a user is rate limited?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the return value of the limit method.
